source: MSM Quest internal definition — common medical student reasoning errors

categories.name: Confusing similar conditions
categories.description: Mistaking one condition for another with overlapping features
categories.remediation_strategy: Side-by-side comparison tables highlighting distinguishing features

categories.name: Reversing cause and effect
categories.description: Confusing the direction of a pathophysiological relationship
categories.remediation_strategy: Causal chain diagrams with directional arrows

categories.name: Incomplete pathophysiology
categories.description: Understanding part of a mechanism but missing key steps
categories.remediation_strategy: Step-by-step mechanism walkthroughs with gap identification

categories.name: Overgeneralization
categories.description: Applying a rule beyond its valid scope

categories.name: Anchoring bias
categories.description: Fixating on an early piece of information despite contradictory evidence
categories.remediation_strategy: Serial re-evaluation exercises with evolving clinical data

categories.name: Availability heuristic
categories.description: Overestimating likelihood of conditions recently encountered
categories.remediation_strategy: Base rate training with epidemiological data

categories.name: Base rate neglect
categories.description: Ignoring prevalence when estimating diagnostic probability
categories.remediation_strategy: Bayesian reasoning exercises with pretest probability

categories.name: Premature closure
categories.description: Accepting a diagnosis before all evidence is considered
categories.remediation_strategy: Forced differential expansion before committing to diagnosis
